caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or cloth with an elaborate repeating floral and geometric pattern. The primary color is a deep blue, and the repeating designs, including flowers, leaves, and symmetrical shapes, are rendered in a lighter blue or white. The textile is bordered by a decorative band featuring similar floral and geometric motifs. At the bottom edge, the phrase "HOLYNESS TO THE LORD" is woven repeatedly, interspersed with some small decorative separators, and the same phrase appears as a mirror image in reverse orientation. In the lower corners, blocks of text indicate "GOSPER R.A. & Co. / Ruffsdale / Copyrighted / 1842" on the right side, and similar notations on the left. A portion of the top right corner of the textile is folded diagonally to reveal the reverse side, which is primarily off-white with the same pattern in blue. The drawing also features a fine line border around the textile, and annotation in the upper right corner of the page.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
